classes.name: plastic
classes.label: Plastic
classes.description: Clean, recyclable plastic containers and packaging accepted under municipal policy.
classes.contamination_rule: Food-soiled or un-rinsed plastics must be routed to general_trash under residual disposal policy.

classes.name: metal
classes.label: Metal
classes.description: Clean, recyclable metal packaging accepted under municipal policy.
classes.contamination_rule: Rinse empty cans. Empty aerosols are accepted; pressurized or hazardous metal is excluded.

classes.name: cardboard
classes.label: Cardboard
classes.description: Clean, dry corrugated cardboard and paperboard packaging.
classes.contamination_rule: Oil and grease prevent repulping. Greasy food-contact cardboard must be routed to general_trash.

classes.name: glass
classes.label: Glass
classes.contamination_rule: Rinse containers. Non-container glass (different melting point) goes to general_trash or specialized drop-off.

classes.name: paper
classes.label: Paper
classes.description: Clean, dry recyclable paper sheets, bags, and publications.
classes.contamination_rule: Keep dry. Wet paper loses fiber integrity. Bio-soiled tissues must be routed to general_trash.

classes.name: general_trash
classes.label: General Trash / Residual Waste
classes.description: Residual, composite, contaminated, and non-recyclable solid waste destined for landfill or waste-to-energy.
accepted_examples: Expanded polystyrene (Styrofoam) cups and food clamshells
Greasy pizza boxes and soiled food packaging
Used facial tissues and soiled paper towels
Single-use plastic straws and plastic cutlery
Toothpaste and cosmetic composite squeeze tubes
Cigarette butts and outdoor litter fragments
classes.contamination_rule: Default destination for all non-recyclable composites and contaminated dry waste.

classes.name: organic
classes.label: Organic / Food Waste
classes.description: Biodegradable food scraps and organic waste accepted for municipal composting or biomethanation.
classes.contamination_rule: Do not bag in non-biodegradable plastic. Keep separate from dry recyclables.
